name: fraud-detection

vulnerabilityDetails.howItWorks: Attackers might exploit overly permissive IAM policies or use compromised credentials to bypass API Gateway authentication.
vulnerabilityDetails.exploitationScenario: An attacker obtains AWS credentials with broad permissions and uses them to bypass API Gateway authentication controls.

recommendations.description: Implement strict IAM policies using least privilege principle
recommendations.implementationDetails: Review and restrict IAM roles to minimum required permissions. Use AWS IAM Access Analyzer to identify unintended access.
Consider adding Cognito user pools or custom authorizers for additional authentication mechanisms.

ground_truth.awsSpecificConsiderations: Use AWS IAM Access Analyzer to continuously monitor for overly permissive policies. Consider implementing AWS Organizations SCPs for additional control.

mitreATT&CK: T1530 - Data from Cloud Storage Object

vulnerabilityDetails.howItWorks: Attackers might exploit misconfigured bucket policies, IAM roles, or encryption settings to access sensitive data.
vulnerabilityDetails.exploitationScenario: An attacker gains access to ML models or transaction data through overly permissive bucket policies or compromised IAM credentials.

recommendations.implementationDetails: Enable S3 Object Lock for critical data, implement bucket policies using least privilege, enable versioning for all buckets, and implement MFA Delete for critical buckets.
Use AWS KMS with customer managed keys instead of S3-managed keys for better control and audit capability.

ground_truth.awsSpecificConsiderations: Use S3 Block Public Access at the account level, enable CloudTrail data events for S3, and regularly audit bucket policies and access patterns.

vulnerabilityDetails.howItWorks: Attackers might attempt to poison the ML model during training or deployment, or launch adversarial attacks against the model.
vulnerabilityDetails.exploitationScenario: An attacker manipulates training data or model artifacts to reduce the accuracy of fraud detection.

recommendations.implementationDetails: Implement model versioning, validation gates, and integrity checks. Use AWS SageMaker Model Monitor to detect drift and data quality issues.
Set up automated monitoring for model performance metrics and implement alerts for unusual patterns or sudden changes in model behavior.

ground_truth.awsSpecificConsiderations: Use SageMaker security features including VPC isolation, KMS encryption, and IAM role separation for different ML pipeline stages.

vulnerabilityDetails.howItWorks: Attackers might attempt to inject malformed data into the Kinesis stream or intercept stream data.
vulnerabilityDetails.exploitationScenario: An attacker manipulates transaction data in the stream to bypass fraud detection rules.

recommendations.implementationDetails: Implement strict input validation at API Gateway, use KMS encryption for the Kinesis stream, and implement detailed logging of stream operations.
Use CloudWatch anomaly detection to monitor stream metrics and implement automated responses to unusual patterns.

ground_truth.awsSpecificConsiderations: Use server-side encryption for Kinesis streams with AWS KMS, implement proper CloudWatch monitoring, and use AWS X-Ray for tracing.

vulnerabilityDetails.howItWorks: Attackers might attempt to extract database credentials from environment variables, logs, or through application vulnerabilities.
vulnerabilityDetails.exploitationScenario: An attacker gains access to RDS credentials stored in Secrets Manager through a compromised Lambda function.

recommendations.implementationDetails: Implement automatic secret rotation, use strict IAM policies for Secrets Manager access, and implement monitoring for secret access patterns.
Enable IAM authentication for RDS, implement proper network isolation, and use encryption at rest and in transit.

ground_truth.awsSpecificConsiderations: Use AWS Secrets Manager for automatic credential rotation, implement AWS Config rules to monitor database configuration, and use AWS GuardDuty for threat detection.

vulnerabilityDetails.howItWorks: Attackers might attempt to overwhelm system resources through various DDoS attack vectors.
vulnerabilityDetails.exploitationScenario: An attacker launches a large-scale DDoS attack against the API endpoints to disrupt fraud detection capabilities.

recommendations.implementationDetails: Enable AWS Shield, implement proper WAF rules, and configure appropriate rate limiting at CloudFront and API Gateway.
Implement proper auto-scaling, use throttling mechanisms, and ensure proper error handling across all components.

ground_truth.awsSpecificConsiderations: Consider using AWS Shield Advanced for enhanced DDoS protection, implement AWS WAF rate-based rules, and use AWS Auto Scaling for resource management.

vulnerabilityDetails.howItWorks: Insufficient logging and monitoring could allow attackers to operate undetected or cover their tracks.
vulnerabilityDetails.exploitationScenario: An attacker performs reconnaissance and initial access attempts without detection due to inadequate logging.

recommendations.implementationDetails: Enable comprehensive CloudTrail logging, implement log aggregation, and ensure proper log retention policies.
Enable GuardDuty with appropriate notification configurations, implement custom CloudWatch metrics and alerts.

ground_truth.awsSpecificConsiderations: Use AWS CloudTrail with log file validation, implement AWS Config for configuration monitoring, and use Amazon EventBridge for automated responses to security events.

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
AWS Real-time Fraud Detection System Architecture Diagram

This diagram illustrates a real-time fraud detection system built on AWS services,
featuring stream processing, machine learning-based detection, and instant alerting.
The system processes transactions in real-time and uses ML models to identify
potentially fraudulent activities.

Key Features:
- Real-time transaction processing
- ML-based fraud detection
- Instant alerts for suspicious activities
- Historical data analysis
- Secure API access
"""

# --- Network and API related imports ---
from diagrams.aws.network import APIGateway, ELB
from diagrams.aws.network import CloudFront

# --- Compute and Serverless imports ---
from diagrams.aws.compute import Lambda, AutoScaling
from diagrams.aws.analytics import Kinesis

# --- Analytics and ML imports ---
from diagrams.aws.analytics import Quicksight
from diagrams.aws.ml import Sagemaker

# --- Database imports ---
from diagrams.aws.database import Dynamodb, RDS, ElastiCache

# --- Storage imports ---
from diagrams.aws.storage import S3

# --- Security imports ---
from diagrams.aws.security import IAM
from diagrams.aws.security import Guardduty

# --- Integration imports ---
from diagrams.aws.integration import SNS, SQS
from diagrams.aws.integration import Eventbridge

# --- Monitoring imports ---
from diagrams.aws.management import Cloudwatch

# --- General diagram imports ---
from diagrams import Diagram, Cluster, Edge
from diagrams.onprem.client import Users
from diagrams.onprem.network import Internet

# Graph attributes for better visualization
graph_attr = {
    "fontsize": "35",
    "bgcolor": "white",
    "splines": "spline",
    "pad": "2.5",
    "nodesep": "1.0",
    "ranksep": "1.2",
    "concentrate": "false"  # Keep edges separate for clarity
}

# Create the diagram with custom configuration
with Diagram(
    name="AWS Real-time Fraud Detection System",
    filename="fraud_detection",
    direction="LR",  # Left to right for data flow clarity
    show=True,
    graph_attr=graph_attr,
    outformat="png"
) as diag:
    
    # External Users and Systems
    users = Users("Customers")
    merchants = Users("Merchants")
    
    # Security and API Layer
    with Cluster("Security & API Layer"):
        cdn = CloudFront("CloudFront\n(with WAF)")
        api = APIGateway("Transaction\nAPI")
        auth = IAM("IAM Auth")
        lb = ELB("Load\nBalancer")
    
    # Transaction Processing Layer
    with Cluster("Transaction Processing (Auto-scaled)"):
        stream = Kinesis("Transaction\nStream")
        with Cluster("Lambda Functions"):
            validator = Lambda("Transaction\nValidator")
            detector = Lambda("Fraud\nDetector")
            rules = Lambda("Rules\nEngine")
        cache = ElastiCache("Rules\nCache")
    
    # ML Layer
    with Cluster("ML Layer"):
        inference = Sagemaker("Real-time\nInference")
        training = Sagemaker("Model Training\n& Feature Engineering")
    
    # Storage Layer
    with Cluster("Storage Layer"):
        transactions = Dynamodb("Transaction\nStore")
        fraud_cases = RDS("Fraud Cases\nDatabase")
        model_store = S3("ML Models")
        data_lake = S3("Data Lake")
    
    # Alerting Layer
    with Cluster("Alert & Response"):
        alerts = SNS("Fraud Alerts")
        cases = SQS("Case Queue")
        guard = Guardduty("Threat\nDetection")
    
    # Analytics Layer
    with Cluster("Analytics"):
        dashboard = Quicksight("Fraud Analytics\nDashboard")
        metrics = Cloudwatch("System\nMetrics")
        events = Eventbridge("Business\nEvents")
    
    # Define relationships
    # Transaction Flow
    users >> Edge(color="blue", label="1. Submit\nTransaction") >> cdn
    merchants >> Edge(color="blue", label="1. Submit\nTransaction") >> cdn
    cdn >> Edge(color="green", label="2. Filter & DDoS Protection") >> api
    api >> Edge(color="green", label="3. Authenticate") >> auth
    api >> Edge(color="blue", label="4. Route") >> lb
    lb >> Edge(color="blue", label="5. Stream") >> stream
    
    # Processing Flow
    stream >> Edge(color="blue", label="Auto-scaled\nProcessing") >> validator
    
    # Fraud Detection Flow
    validator >> Edge(color="orange", label="6. Check Rules") >> rules
    rules >> Edge(color="orange", label="Cache") >> cache
    validator >> Edge(color="purple", label="7. ML Scoring") >> inference
    rules >> Edge(color="orange") >> detector
    inference >> Edge(color="purple") >> detector
    detector >> Edge(color="blue", label="8. Decision") >> api
    
    # Data Storage
    validator >> Edge(color="red", label="Store") >> transactions
    detector >> Edge(color="red", style="dashed", label="Log Cases") >> fraud_cases
    [transactions, fraud_cases] >> Edge(color="orange") >> data_lake
    
    # Alert Flow
    detector >> Edge(color="red", style="bold", label="9. High Risk") >> alerts
    alerts >> Edge(color="red", style="dashed") >> cases
    cases >> Edge(color="red", style="dashed") >> dashboard
    
    # ML Training Flow
    data_lake >> Edge(color="purple", style="dashed", label="Historical\nTransactions") >> training
    training >> Edge(color="purple", style="dashed", label="Save Model") >> model_store
    
    # Monitoring
    guard >> Edge(color="red", style="dotted") >> alerts
    [validator, rules, detector, inference] >> Edge(
        color="gray", style="dotted", label="Performance\nMetrics"
    ) >> metrics
    
    # Event Processing
    [detector, alerts] >> Edge(color="blue", style="dotted") >> events
    events >> Edge(color="blue", style="dotted") >> dashboard

# Note: The diagram will be saved as 'fraud_detection.png' in high resolution
